title: Grayven's Apples
description: Craft enchanted golden apples with gold blocks!
body:
# Grayven's Golden Apples

## Features
- Makes enchanted golden apples craftable again.
- Craftable by surrounding an apple with golden blocks.
- Operator-only commands.

## Commands
### /grayvensapples enable
Enable the crafting recipe.

### /grayvensapples disable 
Disable the crafting recipe.

### /grayvensapples status
Check whether the recipe is enabled.

### /grayvensapples reload
Reload the config.
